description:
One notice (or expiring contract) as its SpendQuery brief, no AI: the notice's facts and
    deadline, the contract it likely follows and how sure the match is, the incumbent and its
    money at the agency, other contracts it may follow, who else wins this work at the agency
    (with set-aside eligibility from their own SAM.gov registrations and how likely each is to
    bid, read from award history only), the contracting office (active contracts, how often its
    competed contracts drew one offer, how it usually buys), what similar work was awarded for
    (award values with options, not bids; prepared by a job, so "pending" the first time: ask
    again in a few minutes), the competitors' GSA ceiling rates and the agency's IT budget. For
    the decision card, the timeline of the buy and file changes: get_notice.

notice_id.description: A SAM.gov notice id (the 32-character hex id in sam.gov/opp/<id>/view, or from search_notices), or an expiring contract's award key from recompetes (e.g. "CONT_AWD_N0010426FB406_9700_N0010426GB401_9700").
notice_id.title: Notice Id
